items.name: bi-autoresearch
items.description: Self-improving experiment loop for GSS skills. Generates prompt variants, tests against real metrics, promotes winners. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch.

items.name: bi-experiment-log
items.description: Track A/B tests and experiments across outreach, content, and pipeline. Log hypotheses, results, and conclusions. Auto-promotes to knowledge/patterns/ after 3+ confirmations.

items.name: bi-pipeline-forecast
items.description: Data-driven pipeline projection using real conversion rates from GSS outreach data. Calculates expected audits, conversations, and revenue from remaining leads.

items.name: bi-weekly-intel
items.description: Weekly intelligence brief that analyses outreach, content, and pipeline data from the past 7 days and produces actionable recommendations. Feeds into fo-briefing on Monday mornings.

items.name: blog-agent
items.description: Run the full blog post pipeline: research, write, generate header image, format for publishing, and save outputs locally.

items.name: blog-writer
items.description: Write research-backed blog posts for gtmsignalstudio.com optimised for both SEO and AEO (AI citation). Includes meta description, internal link suggestions, and a companion LinkedIn teaser post.

items.name: cm-carousel-builder
items.description: Generate a 6-slide LinkedIn carousel for GSS with Twitter-style headers (avatar + blue tick + handle). Uses Python + Playwright.

items.name: copywriter
items.description: Cross-cutting copy optimization skill. Evaluates and improves hooks, titles, subject lines, and CTAs for all content types (blog, newsletter, LinkedIn, YouTube). Generates 3 scored alternatives per element using the 4U+S framework.

items.name: excalidraw-builder
items.description: Use when asked to create a diagram, visual, flowchart, system map, or any Excalidraw output.

items.name: expert-copywriter
items.description: Strategic copywriting intelligence for all GSS departments. Produces a Copy Strategy Brief before writing begins — ICP psychology, narrative approach, storytelling patterns, and CTA strategy aligned to the correct funnel lane. Sits above cm-copywriter (which handles tactical scoring at Step 4). This skill operates at Step 2.5 (between research and writing).

items.name: infographic-builder
items.description: Use when asked to create an infographic, branded image, or visual asset.

items.name: linkedin-agent
items.description: Run the full LinkedIn post pipeline: research (if needed), write, generate companion image, and save outputs locally.

items.name: linkedin-creator
items.description: Use when asked to write a LinkedIn post, LinkedIn carousel, or any LinkedIn content.

items.name: newsletter-agent
items.description: Run the full newsletter pipeline: research, write, generate header image, format for Beehiiv, and save outputs locally.

items.name: newsletter-creator
items.description: Use when asked to write a newsletter, Beehiiv content, email newsletter, or "The GTM Signal" issue.

items.name: cm-saturday-reflection
items.description: Saturday LinkedIn post — personal leadership reflection. The Enterprise Edge pillar. Tech-to-leadership transition, stakeholder management, communication growth, negotiation.

items.name: cm-weekly-content
items.description: Full weekly content production pipeline. Researches keywords and PAA, writes 4 blog posts + 5 LinkedIn posts + 1 newsletter, generates all images, and prepares everything for publishing. One command produces an entire week of content.

items.name: youtube-agent
items.description: Run the full YouTube video production pipeline: research (if needed), write script, generate Excalidraw diagram, generate thumbnail, write metadata, and save outputs locally.

items.name: youtube-scriptwriter
items.description: Use when asked to write a YouTube video script.

items.name: fo-accountability
items.description: Chief Accountability Officer. Runs a single-priority diagnostic on the business. Reads pipeline, campaigns, content, and sprint state, then delivers ONE action that has the highest probability of moving the business toward revenue today. Calls out avoidance patterns. Biases hard toward outward-facing work.

items.name: fo-audit
items.description: AIOS health check for the GSS workspace. Scores the 4 Cs (Context, Connections, Capabilities, Cadence) out of 100, maps coverage against the 7 tier-1 business domains (revenue, customers, calendar, comms, tasks, meetings, knowledge), surfaces the top 3 leverage gaps, and recommends the single next move. Saves results to founder/audits/ so progress compounds across runs.

items.name: fo-briefing
items.description: Morning briefing for the GSS founder. Checks Google Calendar, Gmail, Airtable pipeline, Airtable content calendar, and content backlog to produce today's top 3 priorities focused on the current sprint goal.

items.name: fo-coordinator
items.description: Strategic coordinator for the GSS founder. Analyzes the current state across pipeline, content, and sprint goals, then recommends the single highest-impact action to take right now. Also handles weekly planning and sprint reviews.

items.name: fo-dpo
items.description: Data Protection Officer for GTM Signal Studio. Audits data flows, flags GDPR/PECR exposure, advises on compliance, and generates compliance reports.

items.name: fo-pipeline-pulse
items.description: Check the sales pipeline health and surface urgent actions. Scans the Airtable Campaign-Tracker table for leads going cold, overdue follow-ups, stale prospects, and pipeline gaps.

items.name: fo-signal-funnel
items.description: The Signal Funnel — GSS's lead routing framework. Shows the 3-lane funnel, validates channel routing, and returns the correct CTA for any channel.

items.name: script-writer
items.description: Use when a Python tool script needs to be created, updated, or fixed.

items.name: website-agent
items.description: Manage content for the GTM Signal Studio website (gtmsignalstudio.com). Write blog posts, update page copy, and run SEO audits.

items.name: ai-visibility-audit
items.description: Audit a B2B company's AI visibility across Google AI Mode, Perplexity and ChatGPT. Scores 4 dimensions: AI Citation Presence, Entity Recognition, Content Structure, and Citation Breadth. Produces a scored report (0-100) with a prioritized fix list and PDF.

items.name: icp-research-agent
items.description: Research what ICPs are talking about, asking, and struggling with across communities and forums. Produces structured topic bank with sources, dates, angles, and urgency ratings. Pushes to Airtable and feeds content agents. Use when: "research icps", "icp research", "find topics", "what are icps talking about", "topic research", "research agent", or /icp-research-agent.

items.name: ri-linkedin-signal
items.description: Scan a LinkedIn profile or company for buying signals, score outreach readiness, and generate a signal-led personalized message. Input a name, company, or LinkedIn URL.

items.name: ri-linkedin-signal-report-pdf
items.description: Generate a professional PDF report from the most recent LinkedIn signal scan (single or batch). Produces a branded, client-ready PDF with signal scores, outreach messages, and prioritization dashboard.

items.name: ri-linkedin-signals-batch
items.description: Batch scan 5-10 target companies or people for LinkedIn buying signals. Prioritizes who to contact first and generates personalized outreach for the top 3. Input a list of names, companies, or URLs.

items.name: ri-martech-audit
items.description: Scan any website to detect installed marketing tools, score the stack, and generate a branded PDF report.

items.name: signal-source-method
items.description: Run The Signal Source Method: GSS's 6-step research framework for producing original data that AI platforms cite. Steps: Signal, Scope, Scan, Score, Source, Seed.

items.name: signalled-agent
items.description: Run the SignalLed lead qualification pipeline: fetch signals from Signalbase API, research via Exa, qualify against ICP, enrich emails via Hunter.io, push to Airtable.

items.name: daily-outreach
items.description: Guide the daily manual outreach workflow: Google Maps prospecting, AI Mode visibility check, Gmail email. Target: 5 emails/day to local Kent businesses before noon.

items.name: so-gtm-audit
items.description: Run a full Go-To-Market audit on any B2B company website. Single-pass analysis — no sub-agents. Fetches key pages in parallel, scores 6 categories (including AI Visibility), produces a branded report with prioritized action plan.

items.name: so-gtm-channels
items.description: Audit a B2B company's marketing and sales channel mix. Evaluates presence, activity, and effectiveness across all GTM channels including LinkedIn, blog, email, paid ads, SEO, community, and partnerships.

items.name: so-gtm-content
items.description: Analyze whether a B2B company's content maps to buyer pain points, funnel stages, and search intent. Evaluates content-market fit, topic coverage, and content strategy effectiveness.

items.name: so-gtm-icp
items.description: Analyze a B2B company's Ideal Customer Profile clarity. Evaluates who they target, how well-defined their ICP is, and whether their messaging aligns with their intended audience.

items.name: so-gtm-messaging
items.description: Evaluate a B2B company's messaging and positioning. Analyzes value propositions, differentiation, headline clarity, CTA effectiveness, and positioning against established frameworks.

items.name: so-gtm-report-pdf
items.description: Generate a professional PDF report from the most recent GTM audit. Converts the markdown audit report into a branded, client-ready PDF with scoring visuals, findings tables, and action plans.

items.name: so-gtm-signals
items.description: Detect growth, risk, and competitive signals for a B2B company. Analyzes hiring patterns, funding news, tech stack, competitive landscape, and market positioning signals.
